decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core everyday item made with established recipes and production, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The flagship premium raisin stollen won a repeated gold medal, which clearly exceeds aspirations, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range and uses existing resources, and there is no evidence of a shortfall.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant that faces some risk of range pruning, but it runs on the existing line and slack allows the firm to carry it.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line in the seasonal gift assortment and costs little to keep.
The ancient grain bread is presented as the latest master piece and fits health-oriented demand, so the firm would keep giving it time while its results remain uncertain.
